name: Home Assistant Matter Hub
short_desc: Bridge Home Assistant entities to Matter controllers
author: @RiDDiX
description: Home Assistant Matter Hub simulates Matter bridges to publish your Home Assistant entities to any Matter-compatible controller like Amazon Alexa, Apple Home or Google Home. This is the community-maintained RiDDiX fork that continues development after the original t0bst4r project was discontinued; existing paired devices keep working. It runs in host network mode (required by Matter for mDNS/IPv6 discovery), so it cannot be reverse-proxied — reach the web UI directly at http://<host-ip>:8482. You need a Home Assistant URL and a long-lived access token. Bridges and their entity filters are configured from the web UI; state is persisted in the data volume.

form_fields.label: Home Assistant URL
form_fields.hint: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance, including http(s):// and port.

form_fields.label: Home Assistant access token
form_fields.hint: A long-lived access token. Create it in Home Assistant under your profile > Security > Long-lived access tokens.

form_fields.label: Log level
form_fields.hint: One of: silly, debug, http, info, warn, error.
